data.description:
## Incident Overview

design-md-lint.sh only operates on git diff --cached staged files. When called
with a positional file path argument, it ignores it and emits "No staged files"
exit 0. The fixture test harness (test-design-md-fixtures.sh) calls the linter
with file paths, expecting meaningful exit codes based on violation detection.

Expected: design-md-lint.sh accepts a file path and lints it directly.
Actual: design-md-lint.sh ignores the path, checks staged files, exits 0.

Resolution: Add a DSO_LINT_FILE env var or positional-arg mode to design-md-lint.sh
that accepts a single file path and calls npx directly against it.
data.title: [design-md-lint.sh]: No positional file-arg mode -> fixture test harness cannot exercise violation detection
